[AMD] Enable IEEE maximum/minimum for RDNA4 (#12480)

gfx12 has IEEE-754 2019 maximum/minimum instructions (LLVM's
FeatureIEEEMinimumMaximumInsts, which FeatureGFX12 includes), and
supportMaximumMinimum() already returns true for RDNA4m (gfx117x) and
CDNA5 (gfx1250). Return true for RDNA4 (gfx120x) as well.

Require an opt-in to honor enable_fp_fusion (#12479)

Replace `TRITON_FORCE_DISABLE_FP_FUSION` with the opt-in
`TRITON_ALLOW_FP_FUSION`.

Without the opt-in, implicit FP fusion is disabled regardless of the
`enable_fp_fusion` launch option. Setting `TRITON_ALLOW_FP_FUSION=1`
restores the existing launch-option behavior and
`TRITON_DEFAULT_FP_FUSION` fallback. Explicit fused operations such as
`tl.fma` are unchanged.

commits.message:
[TritonGPU] Fold only uniform select conditions into TMEM stores (#12476)

Resetting a tcgen05 accumulator with `tl.where` crashes compilation for
`cuda:100`, with or without `warp_specialize`:

```python
for kk in tl.range(0, K, BK):
    acc = tl.dot(a_d.load([om, kk]), b_d.load([on, kk]).T, tl.where(kk == 0, 0.0, acc))
```
```
Assertion `isa<To>(Val) && "cast<Ty>() argument of incompatible type!"' failed.
Pipeline failed while executing [`TritonGPUHoistTMEMAlloc` on 'builtin.module' operation]
```

`CombineTMEMStoreAndSelect` turns `tmem_store(select(cond, x,
tmem_load))` into a `tmem_store` predicated on `cond`. Here `cond` is a
splatted `tensor<...xi1>`, which the pattern forwarded into the store's
scalar `i1` predicate; a later rewrite then asserted on the invalid
store. Now a `tt.splat` condition is replaced by its scalar source, and
any other tensor condition makes the pattern bail out, since a scalar
predicate can't express a per-element select.

Tests in `hoist-tmem-alloc.mlir` cover a splatted condition in both
select orientations and a per-element condition (left as a select); each
crashes the pass without the fix.

Full lit passes on 3b0d4f8022 (305 passed, 2 unsupported), and the
kernel above now compiles for `cuda:100` with and without
`warp_specialize`. Not run on Blackwell hardware.

@@ -260,6 +260,51 @@ module attributes {"ttg.num-ctas" = 1 : i32, "ttg.num-warps" = 4 : i32, ttg.targ
 
 // -----
 
+// The tmem_store predicate is a scalar i1: a splatted select condition folds
+// into it as its scalar source, and a per-element condition must not fold.
+
+#blocked = #ttg.blocked<{sizePerThread = [1, 128], threadsPerWarp = [32, 1], warpsPerCTA = [4, 1], order = [1, 0]}>
+#tmem = #ttng.tensor_memory_encoding<blockM = 128, blockN = 128, colStride = 1>
+!acc = !ttg.memdesc<128x128xf32, #tmem, #ttng.tensor_memory, mutable>
+module attributes {"ttg.num-ctas" = 1 : i32, "ttg.num-warps" = 4 : i32, ttg.target = "cuda:100", "ttg.threads-per-warp" = 32 : i32} {
+  // CHECK-LABEL: @select_splat_cond(
+  // CHECK: %[[NEG:.*]] = arith.xori %arg2, %true
+  // CHECK-NEXT: ttng.tmem_store %arg3, %arg0[%arg1], %[[NEG]] :
+  tt.func @select_splat_cond(%tm: !acc, %tok: !ttg.async.token, %cnd: i1, %x: tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked>) -> !ttg.async.token {
+    %true = arith.constant true
+    %v, %load_tok = ttng.tmem_load %tm[%tok] : !acc -> tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked>
+    %c = tt.splat %cnd : i1 -> tensor<128x128xi1, #blocked>
+    %s = arith.select %c, %v, %x : tensor<128x128xi1, #blocked>, tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked>
+    %store_tok = ttng.tmem_store %s, %tm[%load_tok], %true : tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked> -> !acc
+    tt.return %store_tok : !ttg.async.token
+  }
+
+  // CHECK-LABEL: @select_splat_cond_inverted(
+  // CHECK-NOT: arith.select
+  // CHECK: ttng.tmem_store %arg3, %arg0[%arg1], %arg2 :
+  tt.func @select_splat_cond_inverted(%tm: !acc, %tok: !ttg.async.token, %cnd: i1, %x: tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked>) -> !ttg.async.token {
+    %true = arith.constant true
+    %v, %load_tok = ttng.tmem_load %tm[%tok] : !acc -> tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked>
+    %c = tt.splat %cnd : i1 -> tensor<128x128xi1, #blocked>
+    %s = arith.select %c, %x, %v : tensor<128x128xi1, #blocked>, tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked>
+    %store_tok = ttng.tmem_store %s, %tm[%load_tok], %true : tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked> -> !acc
+    tt.return %store_tok : !ttg.async.token
+  }
+
+  // CHECK-LABEL: @select_tensor_cond(
+  // CHECK: %[[SEL:.*]] = arith.select %arg2
+  // CHECK: ttng.tmem_store %[[SEL]], {{.*}}, %true :
+  tt.func @select_tensor_cond(%tm: !acc, %tok: !ttg.async.token, %c: tensor<128x128xi1, #blocked>, %x: tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked>) -> !ttg.async.token {
+    %true = arith.constant true
+    %v, %load_tok = ttng.tmem_load %tm[%tok] : !acc -> tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked>
+    %s = arith.select %c, %v, %x : tensor<128x128xi1, #blocked>, tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked>
+    %store_tok = ttng.tmem_store %s, %tm[%load_tok], %true : tensor<128x128xf32, #blocked> -> !acc
+    tt.return %store_tok : !ttg.async.token
+  }
+}
+
+// -----
+
 #blocked = #ttg.blocked<{sizePerThread = [1, 128], threadsPerWarp = [32, 1], warpsPerCTA = [4, 1], order = [1, 0]}>
 #shared = #ttg.nvmma_shared<{swizzlingByteWidth = 128, transposed = false, elementBitWidth = 16}>
 #shared1 = #ttg.swizzled_shared<{vec = 1, perPhase = 1, maxPhase = 1, order = [1, 0]}>
